title: Repeated failure — same (tool, code, file) fingerprint across two turns, different wording (doom-loop layer 2)
construction: Turn 1 failed the owner-scope test in tests/notes-crud.test.js (vitest). The turn-2 'fix' adds a userId check in the route but misses the source_type case, and the same test fails again with different message text and line numbers. Fingerprint (vitest, notes-crud › owner scope, tests/notes-crud.test.js) is identical across turns. The deterministic layer-1 breaker fires regardless; the case scores the critic's classification.

expected.notes: Caught = same_root_cause true with non-null matches_failure_id and non-empty classification evidence, plus a repeated_failure flag and an escalate verdict.
